plugins.name: remy
plugins.description: Remy 🐀 — invisible sous-chef for Google Docs. Collaborate on a Google Doc through a share link, without a browser. Proposes every change as a native suggestion with Accept/Reject buttons (or as reviewable coloured markup on request), reads and answers comments, and executes @@remy commands left in the document.
